svg.title: 🧭 One engine, every question
svg.desc: $ eshana chart vedic --date 1879-12-30 --time 01:00 --offset-minutes 321 --lat 9.9333 --lon 78.1167 --ayanamsha lahiri | jq -r '.positions[:5][] | "\(.id)\t\(.sign.name) \(.sign.dms)"' $ … | jq -r '.derived_attributes[] | select(.id=="vedic.moon.nakshatra") | .value | "\(.name), pada \(.pada)"' $ eshana muhurta --lat 13.08 --lon 80.27 --tz Asia/Kolkata --start 2026-12-01T00:00:00Z --end 2026-12-04T00:00:00Z --profile abhijit | jq -r '.windows[] | …' $ eshana kp-horary --number 100 --utc 2026-11-24T06:00:00Z --lat 13.08 --lon 80.27 | jq -r '…' $ eshana chart vedic --date 2021-03-14 --time 02:30 --tz America/New_York --lat 40.7 --lon -74 | jq -r '.error | …'
svg.text: The eshana CLI prints one JSON envelope per question; jq picks out a few lines.

g.text: America/New_York was skipped by a clock change
Sidereal positions with sign and degree, under the
Nakshatra and pada come from a versioned rule pack.
Exact [start, end) intervals; Abhijit skips Wednesday.
Number 100 fixes the Ascendant; cusps and sub-lords
A clock time that did not exist is an error with a stable
